items.title: Generate Codex agent prompts from every Claude agent prompt
items.context: Current init hardcodes CODEX_AGENT_FILES to four prompts, so projects initialized by Koala miss koala-review-* and koala-implementer prompts under .Codex/agents.
items.userSees: After koala init, .Codex/agents contains every Koala agent prompt name that appears under .claude/agents, including koala-implementer and koala-review-quality.

happy.desc: koala init generates Codex prompt files for all .claude/agents/*.md source prompts

edge.desc: new Claude agent prompt additions are picked up without editing a Codex whitelist

adversarial.desc: Claude-only hooks/settings/skills are not mirrored into .Codex as fake runtime support

items.title: Verify Codex asset drift against the full agent set
items.context: scripts/verify-codex-assets.mjs currently checks only the hardcoded subset; it should fail when any .claude/agents/*.md prompt is missing or stale in .Codex/agents.
items.userSees: Future koala init regressions fail test:codex-assets or test:entrypoints instead of shipping incomplete or obsolete .Codex/agents files.

edge.desc: test:entrypoints proves a fresh koala init includes representative full-mirror prompts like koala-review-quality and koala-implementer

adversarial.desc: stale Codex-only prompts such as implementer.md or reviewer.md fail verification instead of silently remaining

items.title: Clarify documentation for Claude-only versus mirrored Codex assets
items.context: Docs should state that agent prompts are mirrored, while .claude/hooks, .claude/settings.json, and .claude/skills remain Claude-specific.
items.userSees: README and AGENTS explain that Codex mirrors agent prompts, while Claude hooks, settings, and skills remain Claude-only.

happy.desc: README documents full Codex prompt mirroring and Claude-only runtime assets

edge.desc: .Codex/README template tells users Codex prompt mirroring exists but hooks/settings/skills remain .claude-only

adversarial.desc: documentation does not imply .Codex/hooks or .Codex/settings.json will run in Codex
